node.statement: Because e<=e_rc<=e_cmp, lem-compcb-amplified-compression at level n+1 identifies M_{n+1} tensor S_{P,Q}=S_{I_{n+1} tensor P,I_{n+1} tensor Q} and M_{n+1} tensor S_{Q,P}=S_{I_{n+1} tensor Q,I_{n+1} tensor P}. Zero-padding the matrices in node 1.2 therefore puts C_X and R_Y in precisely those two compressed corners, so their middle projections match and the pair is compatible.
